questions.prompt: An expert runs in print mode, with no screen. A gate calls ctx.ui.confirm without checking ctx.hasUI. What does confirm return?
options: false, so the gate blocks, but only by accident of the stand-in
It waits until a person connects
It throws an error that stops pi
questions.explanation: With no screen, the stand-in UI answers confirm with false. A good gate checks ctx.hasUI and decides on purpose.

questions.prompt: What does it mean that a gate fails closed?
options: It allows the call when it cannot get an answer
It closes the terminal after a block
It refuses the call when it cannot get an answer
It blocks every call of every tool
questions.explanation: Failing closed means refusing when the check cannot get an answer. Failing open would allow the call instead.

questions.prompt: Why does pi need an extension to ask for approval?
options: pi cannot show questions in any mode
pi does not ask for approval before every tool call, so the extension builds that step
The model asks the person by itself
Approval is only possible in JSON mode
questions.explanation: pi has no built-in ask-before-running step. An extension builds one in its tool_call handler.
